rules.reason: 00_applications/* must not import 01_platform_packages/database directly; use 01_platform_packages/supabase client
UI components must be pure; no data layer access
UI must not reach database internals
UI is presentational; data fetching belongs in features/
Theme must not depend on UI; theme is consumed by UI
08_developer_tooling/* are build-time scripts; cannot import 00_applications/* at runtime
08_developer_tooling/* must not import runtime server/client code
01_platform_packages/* must not depend on 00_applications/* (inversion of dependency)
